rules.statement: A co-owner cannot unilaterally alter the form of common property without the consent of other co-owners, and if such an alteration is made without consent, the objecting co-owner can compel the builder to restore the property to its former condition.
rules.supporting_quote: "No alteration in. the form of the common property (such as a building) can ho made by one owner if the other objects. In such a vase, the person who objects is in a superior legal position, and he can compel the person making the alteration to restore the property to its former condition."
